en-US.promoText: Find open class-action settlements, check who qualifies on the official notice, file on the official site, and keep track of your claims.
en-US.description:
Find open class-action settlements, check who qualifies on the official notice, file on the official site, and keep track of your claims.

Companies settle class-action lawsuits over things like data breaches, hidden fees, faulty products and privacy problems. People who were affected can often file a claim. But many never hear about it in time, or aren’t sure the settlement is real.

FIND AN OPEN SETTLEMENT
Browse settlements that are taking claims right now. Every listing shows the payout and the deadline as the source states them.

CHECK WHO QUALIFIES
Each settlement page sums up who qualifies, the payout, the deadline and whether you need proof, then links to the official notice so you can confirm it yourself.

FILE ON THE OFFICIAL SITE
Open the official claim form and copy in the details you saved, like your name, address and email. Filing there is always free, and you send it yourself.

KEEP TRACK OF EVERY CLAIM
Tell us when you have filed and save the confirmation number the official site gives you. Your claims and deadlines stay in one list.
• Confirmation numbers in one place
• Claims grouped by what to do next

DEADLINE REMINDERS
A reminder on this device 7 days and 1 day before each deadline, for claims you haven’t told us you filed.

THE FACTS
• You file every claim yourself on the official settlement website. ClaimMatch never files or submits a claim for anyone.
• If your claim is paid, the settlement administrator pays you directly. We never handle settlement payments.
• Our listings come from SettleSignal, a public data source. We haven’t checked each one yet, so we label them “Unverified” and point you to the official site.
• We don’t give legal advice and can’t tell you whether you qualify. The official notice decides who qualifies.
• We use your information to run your account and keep track of your claims. We don’t sell it.

ClaimMatch is not a law firm, gives no legal advice, never files claims for you and never handles settlement money. The official settlement notice and website are the final word on deadlines, who qualifies and payments, so check them before you act.
